paite: Atung in Pathian in lei leh vante asiam hi.
heading: Thilsiam Thu
english: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

paite: Lei tuh lim leh mel nei lou in, avuak kia ahi a, tui thukpi tung mial in amial hi. Pathian Kha in tuite tung a-opkhum hi.
english: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

paite: Pathian in, "Vak om hen," achi a, huchi in vak ahong omta hi.
english: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

paite: Pathian in vak a-en a, hoih asa hi. Huchi in Pathian in mial a pan vak akhenkheta hi.
english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

paite: Pathian in vak, "Sun" achi a, mial, "Zan" achi hi. Huchi in ani khatna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

paite: Pathian in, "Tuite kikal ah vansin om henla, huai in tuite a pan tuite khenkhia hen," achi hi.
english: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

paite: Pathian in vansin abawl a, vansin tung a tui omte a pan vansin nuai a tui omte akhenkhia a; huan huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

paite: Pathian in vansin, "Van" achi hi. Huchi in ani nihna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

paite: Pathian in, "Van nuai a tuite mun khat ah omkhawm uh henla, gamkeu hong dawk hen," achi a; huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

paite: Pathian in gamkeu, "Lei" achi a; tui omkhawmte Tuipite achi hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

paite: Pathian in, "Lei in loupate, anteh chi neite, thei sing lei a amau chi omdan ding bang zel a gah, agah sung a chi omte omsak hen," achi a, huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

paite: Huchi in lei in loupate, anteh amau chi omdan ding bang a chi neite, sing amau chi omdan ding bang a gah, agah sung a chi omte a-omsak hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

paite: Huchi in ani thumna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

paite: Pathian in, "Sun leh zan khenna ding in vansin ah tanvakte om uhenla, huaite chiamtehnate, hunbite, nite leh kumte theihna hi uhen.
english: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

paite: Lei tanvak ding in van a vansin ah vakte om uhen," achi a, huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

paite: Pathian in tanvak thupi nih abawl a; tanvak thupizaw pen sun a vaihawm ding in, tanvak thupi louzaw pen zan a vaihawm ding in abawl hi. Aksite leng abawl hi.
english: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

paite: Pathian in huaite lei tanvak ding in van a vansin ah akoih a;
english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

paite: sun tung leh zan tung a vaihawm ding leh vak leh mial khen ding in. Huchi in Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

paite: Huchi in ani lina ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

paite: Pathian in, "Tuite'n thilsiam tang thei hinna neite tampi pawtsak uhenla, vasate leng leitung a vansin hawm heuhou ah leng uhen," achi hi.
english: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

paite: Pathian in ngapi liante asiam a, ganhing tang thei chiteng tui in apawtsak a, amaute chi omdan ding bang leh kha nei vasa chiteng amaute chi omdan ding bang in asiam hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

paite: Pathian in, "Chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, tuipi tuite dimsak unla, vasate leng lei ah pung uhen," chi in avualzawl hi.
english: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

paite: Huchi in ani ngana ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

paite: Pathian in, "Lei in ganhing amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in; gante, bokvak a pai ganhingte, gamsate, amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in pawtsak uhen," achi a; huan huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

paite: Pathian in gamsa amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in, gante amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in, lei a thil bokvak a paite tengteng amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in abawl hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

paite: Pathian in, "I kibatpih in, eimah bang in mihing i bawl dia, tuipi a ngasate tung ah, tung a leng vasate tung ah, gante tung ah leh leitung tengteng tung ah thu i neisak ding," achi hi.
english: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

paite: Pathian in ama kibatpih in mihing asiam a, akibatpih mah in ahi asiam; pasal leh numei asiamta hi.
english: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

paite: Pathian in amaute avualzawl hi. Pathian mah in akiang uah, "Chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, leitung luahdim unla, na thuthu un omsak un. Tuipi a ngasate tung ah, tung a leng vasate tung ah, thil hing leitung a bokvak a pai tengteng tung ah thu nei un," achi hi.
english: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

paite: Pathian mah in, "Ngai un, leitung tengteng a anteh chi nei om teng leh sing chiteng, sing chi nei gah omnate, ka hon pia hi; na an ding uh ahi.
english: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

paite: Lei a gamsa chiteng kiang ah, tung a leng vasa chiteng kiang ah, leitung a bokvak a pai chiteng kiang ah, hinna nei chiteng kiang ah a-an ding un loupa hing chiteng ka pia hi," achi a; huan huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

paite: Pathian in athilsiam tengteng a-en a, ngai in, hoih asa mahmah hi. Huchi in ani gukna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
